title: Parsing UART Packet Frame using Pointer Arithmetic
description:
Embedded protocols frequently pass raw binary byte packets over serial interfaces (UART, SPI, USB).

### Packet Structure:
- Byte 0: SOF (Start of Frame)
- Byte 1: Command Code (cmd)
- Bytes 2..3: 16-bit payload length (little-endian: `byte[2] | (byte[3] << 8)`)
- Bytes 4..7: 32-bit payload word (little-endian)
- Byte 8: Checksum

### Task:
Implement `parse_frame(const uint8_t *raw)` using pointer offsets (`*(raw + i)`).
hint: Remember that multi-byte integers in little-endian format place the least significant byte at the lower memory address.
